We’re absolutely satisfied with everything they’ve done for us, and especially with the communication with Buddy, our project manager. They handled everything perfectly and it all went faster than the timeline we originally got. I would 100% recommend these guys. Thanks for your professionalism and quality of work!

I shopped around and meet several sales people. I wanted a quality built pool for a fair price but also and more importantly backed by a company with a strong backbone.

I would highly recommend Venture Pools for your consideration.  The overall experience was marked by professionalism. Bret the project manager was responsive and accommodating and Angelica was on point with scheduling.  The finished product excelled my expectations.

Venture did an awesome job from design to finish on our pool.  Mark Leuthold’s design was perfect and he helped guide us through material and color selection.  Bret was their hands on supervisor, overseeing every aspect of the job from start to finish.  We are thrilled at the entire process and would highly recommend Venture Pools to build your pool.

The whole experience of building a new pool was way easier than I expected. The crew showed up on time and actually cared about the little details. You can tell they used quality materials because everything feels solid and well made.

They helped us reimagine our older home with a complete remodel. The design was creative, and the builders were clearly skilled at what they do. The results look modern but still kept the character we loved.

Had a great experience working with Mark and Bret. Marks design for our unique space was far and away better than any of the other designs from other companies. Very impressed. Execution has been great and they’ve been attentive to addressing any concerns or changes we have had or made along with way. It’s been an amazing to see it come together so quickly.

As with any build, it is inevitable to run into issues, and Amanda from their office was great at following up with resolutions and keeping on top of the contractors. She continued to follow up on unresolved issues after construction was complete, until everything was pretty much perfect. Josh, my construction manager was great and always willing to answer questions.
The Venture contractors are polite, does quality work, and leaves a clean work site.

reviews.text:
The pool that Venture custom built for us was splendid. Make sure you do your own research when building a pool! Know what components and features you want in a pool or you may get pool builders upselling you on it (this is for inground). We went with Venture Custom Pools after interviewing about 5 different builders.

Below is a breakdown of how we selected our pool builder.

In order:

1. Picked a pool company that was willing to work with our budget, had a good track record of building pools (# of pools built the past 2-3 years. Had good sales/revenue records to prove that they build pools -- had reliable/stable trade-crews w/ good reputation).

- Venture checked that box.

2. Picked a pool company that had good warranties (not just the pool equipment but craftsmanship warranties as well so they follow-up and fix/address problematic tiles, coping, defects, etc.)

- Venture checked that box and has addressed issues (nothing ever goes to plan or is perfect..)

3. We cared a lot about customer service (once the contract was signed) so we wanted to make sure we picked a pool company with good communication skills (I asked to make sure our project manager (Thanks Bret!) would update us frequently, be available to answer questions, etc.. throughout the whole process. If I didn't sense the pool company would be transparent and communicative, I moved on to the next pool company (some companies will seem to be responsive until you sign with them).

-Venture assigned Bret who made himself available to us throughout the entire process

4. Know what components and features you want or don't want in a pool or you may get pool builders upselling you on it (this is for inground). Also, stick to your budget and ask what options you have!

-Venture understood what I wanted and what we were looking for (didn't try to upsell us). They made suggestions but my family and I knew where we were going to spend and where we were going to go lower cost on.

Ultimately, what was most important to us was a company that would stand behind their work, team and deliver (not necessarily on-time but close to it). Venture Custom Pools did that.

With any project, there were delays due to weather (rain/hail) and scheduling issues due to backed up clients. My family didn't expect the schedule to go to plan even though Venture said it could be done on a given timeline. While it could've obviously gone better, faster, and efficient, we felt Venture Custom was better than the other builders we interviewed because they were willing to fix issues post-build.

Would we build a pool with them again? The answer is Yes.

If Venture Custom Pools could improve here is what I would suggest employees at Venture Custom Pools focus on.

- Explain all the options of what is possible given the budget
- Explain the soil injections (pool shell/decking)
- Ask how we want our pool to be cleaned (robot, suction-wall, auto cleaning features)
- Explain why sand or cartridge is better
- Explain salt vs. chlorine
- Explain auto-fill water vs. manual fill
- Explain how important positioning/placement of pool lights are, not just about led strength
- Explain drain holes and its locations and why
- Explain why one would need 1 or 2 skimmers
- Be proactive in scheduling and informing clients of when trades are scheduled and when it has been re-scheduled for a later date.

In general, I enjoyed my pool building experience. If you're looking for a company that will work with you to get what you want done pick Venture Custom Pools over the many out here in the DFW area.

Remember, the cost of building a pool is typically more than an expensive luxury vehicle (the one we built was our second largest purchase -- second to our home).

Pick a high-quality pool builder like Venture Custom Pools that have good crews (trades) and will support and fix issues that arise...(because there will be!).

He presented an excellent initial design proposal based on our initial discussions and was very accommodating in making modifications to suit our preferences. The ability to view a virtual image of the proposed pool was incredibly convenient and allowed us to visualize the final outcome before any work began. Mark provided valuable suggestions and guidance based on his extensive knowledge and experience, which was immensely helpful throughout the process.
Following the finalization of the design, we were introduced to Buddy Phillips, the Construction Manager, who efficiently organized the construction timeline. Buddy was proactive in keeping us informed of any delays or issues that arose during the construction phase. Whenever we had questions, Buddy promptly provided comprehensive answers, ensuring we remained fully informed throughout the project. Additionally, as we had to travel internationally during the construction period, Buddy was accommodating in rescheduling the construction activities to ensure we could observe crucial stages of the process. Even after the construction was finished, Buddy continued to offer strong support by addressing our inquiries and attending to post-construction requirements. He dedicated considerable time to thoroughly explain the operation instructions for the pool and promptly responded to any questions we had, spending hours ensuring we were fully informed.
Overall, our experience with Venture Custom Pool, Mark, and Buddy exceeded our expectations, and we are thrilled with the final result of our pool.

reviews.text:
I’m a general contractor myself,  and really wanted to build the pool myself, but I wanted to be 100% sure that it was going to be supervised from someone with years of dedication and experience specially with in-ground pools. I shopped around and meet several sales people. I wanted a quality built pool for a fair price but also and more importantly backed by a company with a strong backbone.

I have heard several pool companies starting jobs and then shut down their doors. This is why I went with Venture Custom Pools. I had met with one of the senior sales guys name Mark a few years back when we first built our home. I remembered that he was patient communicative super experience in the field and genuinely wanted to just build pools for his clients family to enjoy. Trust me, he doesn’t need the sale. Their was no pushy tactics or unnecessary add-ons. Simply meeting the needs of what you want in your budget.

Fast forward to July 2023, and we agreed on a design and a price that was reasonable. Like I said, I shopped around.

Around 15 days later, we receive the approved permits from the city. There was a little hold up on our end with our HOA but we received the green light.

We met our pool manager by the name of Buddy. Yes, that is his real name. He was super awesome. He stated that he doesn’t wanna make any promises but by the way things were looking and how he was setting up his schedule, he would have this project done, swim ready in five weeks.  I was a little optimistic because I know the average time it takes with all the permit process, weather and other unforeseen delays.

He kept us up to speed on everything that was taking place and shared so much knowledge, as he is very experienced in every aspect in the pool industry.

Within four weeks, our pool was complete. Yes, four weeks and swimming.  When you have a good manager that stays on top of his crew, back by a good company, this is the result. Our pool is beautiful. It’s even better than we thought it was going to be. Special shout out to my man Buddy! Keep up the good work. And thanks for giving us enough weekends to enjoy the pool before we entered the colder season.

The good: Bret the construction manager and Mark the designer were great to deal with. They designed and built our pool, hot tub and outdoor kitchen exactly as planned. Our backyard is now an oasis that we use all the time. It's absolutely stunning!

The bad: They contract out everything as opposed to having their own crews. I did not know this going in. Some of these contractors were good, some not so much. They ask for payments ahead of schedule in my opinion, which takes away your leverage to get things done. In my opinion, you should have 50% paid when 50% of the work is completed, 75% when 75% completed, etc. I had about 90% paid when they were half way done. But, they got everything done regardless of this. I am just not a trusting person when it comes to making such large payments.

What to expect: These were our experiences...Plan on about 45 days after signing your contract to get financing in order, HOA and City approval. Plan on the project taking about 5-6 months if you are doing a more elaborate pool/hot tub/kitchen set-up. Plan on trades not showing up as scheduled. This is just the name of the game in construction, along with weather delays. Plan on $100 - $125K for a starter pool, $150K and up for something cool, and over $200K for something jaw dropping. Don't think your expenses are over after you pay your final payment to Venture. To properly maintain a pool, unless you are an expert, you will need to hire a weekly maintenance company at a cost of around $200 a month. We hired Sobral and they have been great. Our salt water has stayed crystal clear and perfect. Your utility bills will also go up significantly, and we haven't even used the heater feature yet. I would estimate we spend $600 extra a month in added utilities and pool maintenance. This is something you should know and consider going in to it.

Bottom line: I would highly recommend Venture Pools based on our experience. Zero regrets. It will not be a smooth process to get from beginning to end, but they will deliver a great final product. I appreciate that Bret still follows up with me months later, and Mark is truly a great design guy. Venture is very good at what they do!

I met with Venture Pools & one other company, I felt the other company told me what I wanted not being interested in what I said I wanted.  Tina in the office sent me daily emails as to the next step throughout the entire process.  She was very prompt in her replies & always very professional.  David my project manager was very informative, talkative & easy going.  I highly recommend Venture Pools due to the entire process which took a little under two months.  We have had many great compliments including the inspector from the city.  I love my beautiful new pool and cannot wait to start enjoying it!
reviews.author: Nita

reviews.text: Their crew was extremely professional and treated our property with care. The finished pool is stunning, and we've already had multiple neighbors ask who did it. We’re beyond happy.
reviews.author: Davis Fam

reviews.text: We just completed our pool with Venture. They did a fantastic job. Greg sold us on going with Venture after talking to several companies. His process was great.  He listened to what we wanted and delivered on design/budget.  From there we worked with Geoff who is the absolute BEST!  He knows his stuff, has great customer service skills, and was always on top of everything. We are very pleased with how things turned out and will be be referring them to anyone looking to build a pool.
reviews.author: Stephanie Lauck

reviews.text: FIVE STARS! Ken was a great help to us and answered all our questions when designing the pool of our dreams and helping us make our selections. The crew was professional, on time, and completed the build quicker than we anticipated. I highly recommend this company to anyone looking for a beautifully built pool!
reviews.author: B

reviews.text: The team at Venture Custom Pools was great Gregg was timely and very helpful during our design phase and was able to help make our pool truly custom. During the construction process Brett was our project manager and he was excellent. He was easy to communicate with and very prompt when answering our questions. Overall it was an exceptional experience and would highly recommend Venture when building a pool.
reviews.author: Christopher Winebar

reviews.text:
We built our pool and gazebo with Venture! Turned out amazing! They made sure everything was perfect, and they care to listen when you have questions or concerns. We had only one issue (which is amazing when is regarding construction haha) and they addressed and fixed without a problem! Between Geoff Waco (our construction manager) , Gregg (sales and project design) and Amanda - office , they were all amazing! Great communication, fast response and always focus on meeting our needs and to make us happy!
We would definitely recommend Venture Pools !
reviews.author: Monica Veiga Kirsten

reviews.text: Ken and Bret were both fantastic through the entire process of building with them. Ken put a ton of thought into the design of our pool and really went above and beyond to make it fit the space beautifully. Bret was fantastic as a project manager! His communication was excellent and always kept us in the loop on what was going on. We started this pool the last week of august and its complete just short 8 weeks later.  I would absolutely build with venture again in the future should we ever make a move.
reviews.author: George v

reviews.text: Basic pool, concrete, and patio cover, however Venture made it to be a long rough project, but it’s finally finished after many “do overs” due to sub contracted trades doing poor work then me reporting the short comings to the GM, then days and sometimes weeks for remediation without any progress in between. Must pay for everything before work continues, leaves the homeowner feeling uneasy without any recourse if not done right. 3 out of 5 stars is fair. I’d recommend more immediate quality control on the subs, difficult task in this day and age, but necessary for a successful project.
reviews.author: Jeff Payne

reviews.text: The best pool builders in Conroe, hands down. The team’s communication, craftsmanship, and ability to stick to timelines made our experience stress-free. Our infinity-edge pool turned out better than we ever imagined!
reviews.author: Miranda

reviews.text:
We evaluated a handful of pool companies in the Frisco area and ultimately landed on Venture due to their great design and knowledgeable sales person (Gregg was great.) Once the project started, we were handed off to Bret and he was fantastic.

The pool was built in half the time that we were expecting. I honestly didn’t believe them when they said three months; it only took 2.5 months. Not only that but Bret kept us up to date at every step of the process so we knew what was coming up next.

Like any construction project, timelines were fluid due to weather and other outside factors but we were thrilled to see progress being made every single week. The final product was exactly what we were hoping for. I’d happily recommend Venture Pools for anyone in the North Dallas area looking for a pool.
reviews.author: Kevin Peters

reviews.text:
I could not be happier with the outcome of my pool build project with Venture Custom Pools.  This is my first experience having a pool built and was not sure what to expect but I can honestly say that it was the smoothest construction project I have ever been involved in.

My project manager, Buddy, went above and beyond throughout the project to keep me informed at every step and to ensure that I was satisfied with the work that was done.  Anything that came up during the process was handled quickly and professionally and always to my satisfaction.  Not sure how Buddy got it done in 4 weeks (yes, I said 4 WEEKS from dig day to filling the pool with water!!) but everything from planning and design to construction to wrap up exceeded my expectations.

If you are thinking about having a pool built in the DFW area, you won't find a better partner than Venture Custom Pools, make sure to ask for Buddy by name!
reviews.author: Matt Eastman

reviews.text: We love our new Venture pool and spa!  Our Project Manager, Brett was the BEST, (Venture needs to duplicate him!!). He was very professional, and was always there to answer our many questions....he never left us wondering what the next steps were.  The ladies in the office were great as well, especially Amanda who kept us updated almost daily while the final work was being performed.  Would HIGHLY recommend Venture Pools!
reviews.author: Mel C

reviews.text:
We started our pool around Thanksgiving & it was complete the end of January!   The process was seamless.  Tim, the designer,  listened to what we wanted and showed us computer images so we could visualize the pool.
Randy, our contractor was great!  He walked me through the process and every group of contractors that came out did a great job.
Stephanie & Angelica, construction coordinators were on top of everything!  I always received an email about who was coming & what they were coming to do!  They always kept us updated and in the loop on anything!  I felt comfortable calling or emailing them about anything!!!
Yes my yard looked like a war zone,  but they cleaned and smoothed everything to look great again!!!!!!
I highly recommend this company and are very thankful we chose VENTURE Custom Pools!
reviews.author: Aimee Lewis

reviews.text: We started our pool right at the hype of covid when there was shortage of material and labor. Our project took longer than we've been told but communication was very good throughout the process. Not everything turned out the way we wanted but that's where the Project Manager makes the whole difference in the world. Geoff was fantastic and took care of everything that was not done right. Venture went above and beyond and ended up delivering a great product. Having a reputable company like Venture made the difference but having a professional of the caliber of Geoff made everything perfect. We could not be happier with the final product. We highly recommend Venture and if you can have Geoff managing your project you will be on your way of being a happy customer.
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: In the world of pool contractors, Venture Custom Pools is the height of professionalism. Their unique swimming pool design beyond my expectations, and I was astounded by the level of detail that went into it. My pool has been kept in excellent shape by their normal repairs and maintenance services, and the fibreglass swimming pool construction was faultless. Strongly advised!
reviews.author: Rheanna Kralicek

reviews.text: The team was friendly, punctual, and highly skilled. We had them remodel an older pool that came with our house, and the transformation is unbelievable. I'd definitely hire them again!
reviews.author: Ari Bolt

reviews.text: We’ve had a great experience building a pool and spa from start to finish with Venture Pools. Ask for Gregg Whitley as your Design Consultant. He came to our house, spent a lot of time taking leveling measurements to come up with the best starting game plan for us. And what we liked most is there was no pushing or “selling”. Gregg and Venture have a philosophy that everyone should be able to have a state of the art pool design and build with the same high quality equipment and warranty no matter what your budget. And the entire build process was as smooth as it could be - Jeremy, Angelica and Amanda were always in touch with any updates or change in schedule. A great experience from start to finish - Venture really has this building Pools the right way - down to a science. Feel free to email me for anymore details and if this referral helped you decide, let them know Lane Shannon’s review helped.
